stem.text: A teacher sets up the apparatus shown to demonstrate a double-slit interference pattern on a screen.

stem.alt: Apparatus with a source of light, a single slit, a double slit and a screen in a line. Distance p is marked between the single slit and the double slit, a distance q is marked across the double slit, and distance r is marked between the double slit and the screen.

stem.text: Which change to the apparatus will increase the fringe spacing?

D.text: decrease the wavelength of the light
